title: VIBE: Voice-Induced open-ended Bias Evaluation for Large Audio-Language Models via Real-World Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring distributional shifts (using Normalized Total Variation Distance) in structured attributes (e.g., occupations, hobbies) extracted from open-ended model responses when prompted with real-world audio recordings of male and female speakers reciting neutral sentences.

Measuring distributional shifts (using Normalized Total Variation Distance) in structured attributes extracted from open-ended model responses when prompted with real-world audio recordings of speakers with various non-native English accents (Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, and Vietnamese).
